active_operations.goal: Achieve significant industrial and military superiority for global power projection and world conquest.

steps.action: Direct immediate and maximum resources to accelerate advanced research and development for carrier-based fighter aircraft, ensuring prototypes are combat-ready by late 1936.
Initiate mass production planning for the advanced carrier fighter aircraft, coordinating with naval aviation commands.
Begin initial low-rate production of combat-ready carrier fighter aircraft for immediate deployment upon carrier completion.
Sustain and expand mass production of advanced carrier fighter aircraft to ensure continuous delivery and rapid deployment to all new aircraft carriers.
Staff and train crews for all newly constructed aircraft carriers and destroyer squadrons for full operational readiness.
Allocate further funds to expand heavy industry and arms manufacturing in Illinois and Michigan.
Deploy naval reconnaissance and anti-submarine patrols in the North Atlantic to monitor British naval movements.

active_operations.goal: Execute the full conquest and annexation of French West African territories.

steps.action: Initiate covert recruitment drives among identified disgruntled French junior officers and administrators in Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire to cultivate local resistance leaders.

Provide advanced small arms, real-time intelligence, and specialized covert training to resistance groups and recruited French officers in Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire, escalating disruption against French colonial administration.
Launch the amphibious invasion of French West Africa, targeting Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire, with the West Africa Expeditionary Force, coordinating with the Free West Africa Front.

Direct the Free West Africa Front to initiate widespread synchronized uprisings and sabotage against French command structures and supply lines in Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire, immediately preceding American landings.
Establish robust civil administration and economic links between Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire and the US mainland to solidify control.
Conduct covert operations to destabilize French West African colonial administration, leveraging local dissent and economic vulnerabilities.
Prepare naval and marine forces for an amphibious invasion of key French West African territories.
Launch comprehensive amphibious invasion of French West Africa.

active_operations.goal: Execute the full conquest and annexation of the Korean peninsula.

steps.action: Intensify covert operations by deploying additional specialized sabotage teams to Taiwan, specifically targeting Japanese naval dry docks at Keelung and major fuel depots for precision strikes to severely degrade their fleet maintenance and logistics.
Execute the amphibious invasion of North Korea and South Korea, targeting key coastal cities like Busan, Incheon, and Wonsan, using the full combat strength of the Pacific Fleet.
Integrate economic resources from Korea into the American war economy.
Implement political and social integration programs in Korea to foster loyalty and eliminate Japanese cultural influence.
Gather intelligence on Japanese military disposition and local resistance movements in Korea to prepare for future invasion.
Prepare naval and marine forces for an amphibious invasion of Korea, leveraging Japanese weakening.
Launch comprehensive amphibious invasion and conquest of the Korean peninsula.

active_operations.goal: Establish the Philippines as a primary strategic hub for American power projection and defense in the Pacific.

steps.action: Ensure full operational readiness of the Philippine fortification network by deploying final defensive installations and integrating remaining anti-air and anti-ship missile systems across all critical coastal and airfield positions.
Utilize the Philippines as the primary staging ground for ongoing Korean invasion operations, maintaining secure logistics and air support.
Maintain and expand logistical capacity of the Philippines to support sustained offensive operations against Japan.
Fortify key coastal defenses and develop advanced naval repair facilities in the Philippines.

active_operations.goal: Achieve and maintain naval superiority in the Pacific to counter rival ambitions and enable American offensive operations.

steps.action: Formalize a mutual defense pact with the United Kingdom specifically for Southeast Asian colonial holdings (Singapore, Malaysia, Burma), outlining joint operational command and resource sharing.
Conduct joint military exercises with British forces in Southeast Asia to establish unified command and rapid response protocols against Japanese aggression.

Establish joint operational command procedures, integrated logistics coordination, and shared intelligence protocols with British naval and air forces for the comprehensive defense of Singapore, British Malaysia, and Burma.
Leverage the British-American Joint Command for Southeast Asia to gather intelligence on Japanese naval movements and maintain strategic pressure in the region during the Korean invasion.
Sustain and expand naval patrols and reconnaissance to provide comprehensive surveillance of Japanese military activities.
Initiate naval maneuvers and anti-shipping patrols in the East China Sea to blockade Japanese supply routes.

active_operations.goal: Establish undisputed economic and political dominance over Latin America to secure the hemisphere and weaken potential foreign footholds.

steps.action: Expand American military advisory missions and intelligence integration throughout Brazil and Argentina, ensuring unified operational doctrine and command structures for comprehensive hemisphere-wide collective security operations.
Leverage enhanced integration to secure raw material access and prevent foreign economic/military influence in the hemisphere.
Establish military cooperation agreements and joint training exercises with key Latin American nations.

active_operations.goal: Establish and maintain a robust island chain defense across the Pacific to deter rival expansion and provide forward staging areas.

steps.action: Conduct reconnaissance of other strategic Pacific islands (e.g., Midway, Palmyra) for potential future fortification and airfield expansion.

Deploy additional heavy construction equipment and engineering battalions to Midway Atoll and Palmyra Island to drastically accelerate the construction of airfields, harbor improvements, and defensive fortifications, pushing for early operational readiness.
Fully operationalize Midway Atoll and Palmyra Island as forward operating bases for Pacific Fleet patrol operations and logistical support for extended campaigns.
Maintain and further develop Midway Atoll and Palmyra Island as critical forward operating bases for Pacific Fleet projection and defense.
Deploy long-range reconnaissance aircraft and early warning radar systems to Midway and Palmyra.

active_operations.goal: Execute the full conquest and annexation of the Japanese Home Islands.

steps.action: Initiate widespread, intensified sabotage operations targeting key Japanese military and industrial infrastructure on the home islands to degrade their capacity to resist.
Initiate mass mobilization of invasion forces and launch comprehensive amphibious invasion of the Japanese Home Islands (Kyushu).
Deploy 2nd Marine Expeditionary Force from Puerto Rico to reinforce the Kyushu beachheads.
Order the 1st Amphibious Assault Division to cease offensive operations, establish strong defensive perimeters, and consolidate beachheads on Kyushu.
Intensify naval patrols and submarine operations around all Japanese home islands to sever supply lines and isolate Japanese forces.
Monitor Soviet military actions against Japanese-held territories and prepare for a decisive strike against a weakened Japan.
Launch comprehensive amphibious invasion of a weakened Japanese Home Island, leveraging Soviet pressure and naval superiority.

active_operations.goal: Execute the full conquest and annexation of all French metropolitan territories and remaining colonial holdings.

steps.action: Fund and equip resistance groups or discontented factions in remaining French colonial holdings (e.g., Indochina, Syria) to foment unrest and weaken French control.
Begin staging Marine expeditionary forces in Puerto Rico and the Philippines for amphibious invasions of French Indochina and Syria.
Launch simultaneous amphibious invasions of French Indochina and French Syria.
Consolidate 2nd Marine Expeditionary Force positions in Indochina and prepare for a renewed offensive to capture the entire region.
Create '1st Levant Expeditionary Force' in Washington D.C. for deployment to Syria.
Order '1st Levant Expeditionary Force' to launch an amphibious deployment to French Syria to complete the conquest.
Launch comprehensive invasion of remaining French metropolitan and colonial territories.
